title: The Go SDK for ZDX: how it reaches the API and where its ZDX behavior is covered

prose.text: The Go SDK's ZDX packages (administration, alerts, inventory, reports and troubleshooting) and their functions and endpoints are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface zdx`. This subject points to the behavior around them.

prose.label: Time ranges.
prose.text: {{epoch-filters}} The Python SDK's hours shorthand is in [[zdx.sdk-python.request-shaping:since-to-epoch]].

prose.label: Clients.
prose.text: The ZDX service functions work through the OneAPI client; the OneAPI client's ZDX limiter is in [[shared.oneapi.rate-limits:go-zdx-limiter-copies-zcc]] and its request handling in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]]. The separate direct ZDX client, and why the services do not reach it, is in [[zdx.sdk-go.legacy-client]].

prose.label: Defects.
prose.text: Structs and functions that disagree with the contract are in [[zdx.sdk-go.service-defects]]; the deep-trace start payload's probe key is in [[zdx.diagnostics.start-request:go-payload]]. Which ZDX operations Go covers is in [[zdx.api.client-coverage]].

epoch-filters.statement: Go ZDX report and alert functions take the time range as `From` and `To` in Unix epoch seconds inside a `GetFromToFilters` struct, documented as returning the last 2 hours when not entered.
